failedAttempt.stage: prepareGroupChat initial conversation selection, before measurements
failedAttempt.error: Playwright waited for initial navigation although the application and group were displayed.
failedAttempt.handling: Retained failure and trace. Performance fixture now selects only after its required explicit width-preference reload; default BDD selection and assertions remain unchanged. Paired dev measurements were collected with this corrected setup.

definitions.maxFrame: Maximum click-to-settled requestAnimationFrame callback interval, including initial click work.
definitions.animationMaxFrame: Maximum complete rAF interval wholly inside the original 300ms panel width transition; excludes initial click work, which maxFrame still reports.
definitions.elapsed: Click through completed finite animations and content readiness; includes test orchestration.
definitions.warm: Subsequent reopens of the already mounted execution tab.
definitions.cold: First opening of the execution tab in each fresh application batch.

limits: Isolated long group chat fixture, no personal data or remote model calls.
Production: 3 cold and 27 warm observations per side; development: 2 cold and 10 warm observations per side.
Small samples: medians and ranges only, no P95 or FPS certification.
rAF callback intervals are not a physical display/GPU presentation measurement.
Live streaming, arbitrary huge personal histories, other platforms and long-run memory are not qualified.
